info.title: MoneyPilot API
info.description: Household planning API. Money is integer cents, dates are YYYY-MM-DD, errors are RFC 9457 problem+json with a `code` (BACKEND_PLAN §8.1). The API never moves money.

in.description: Where the invalid value was sent

path.description: Dot path inside that part, e.g. `schedule.dayOfMonth`; empty for the root

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type

instance.description: Request path, without the query string

current.description: The current resource, on a version conflict (If-Match)

email.description: Verified email from the sign-in provider

forwardingToken.description: Local part of the household's forwarding address

timezone.description: Defaults to the signed-in user's time zone
